name: cbot
description: cbot: a team of Hermes agents, each with its own screen on one computer.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test:box && npm run test:speech
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
